# 热力循环与效率

_Thermodynamic Cycles & Efficiency_

布雷顿循环把压缩、加热、膨胀等过程联系起来，是理解燃气涡轮的基础。理想循环便于说明趋势；实际发动机还要计入部件效率、压损、冷却和机械功率消耗。

_The Brayton cycle connects compression, heat addition and expansion. Ideal cycles reveal trends; real-engine analysis also accounts for component efficiency, pressure losses, cooling and mechanical power extraction._

## 阅读要点 / Reading Notes

- 沿发动机站位追踪总温、总压、流量和功率的变化。

_Follow total temperature, total pressure, mass flow and power through the engine stations._

- 分清热效率与推进效率：燃气产生机械能的过程，与这部分能量如何转化为有效推进，关注的问题不同。

_Distinguish thermal efficiency from propulsive efficiency: energy conversion within the engine and useful propulsion address different questions._

- 将理想循环假设单独列出，再逐项加入实际损失，比较结论如何变化。

_List ideal-cycle assumptions explicitly, then introduce losses one at a time to examine how the conclusions change._
